responsibility: This header declares the checking-build helper diagnostic context used by GCC selftests. It defines selftest::test_diagnostic_context, a small diagnostic_context subclass configured for deterministic, caret-rich diagnostic rendering and with a custom start-span callback suitable for comparing expected output in tests.
same_name_distinction: This .h file only declares the test_diagnostic_context subclass API for diagnostic selftests, whereas gcc/selftest-diagnostic.cc provides the actual initialization, teardown, and filename-sanitizing start_span callback implementation.
